name: Cave
description: A damp underground cavern. Shadows cling to the walls and echoes carry far.

name: Plains
description: Open grasslands with clear skies and little cover.

name: Desert
description: Scorching sands stretch in every direction under a relentless sun.

name: Swamp
description: A murky bog of thick mud and choking mist.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: Crumbling stone structures humming with residual arcane energy.

name: Volcanic
description: Rivers of molten rock wind between jagged obsidian spires.

name: Forest
description: Dense woodland where shadows blur and underbrush conceals movement.
